description: This file defines a class 'DataValidator' responsible for validating cell values according to various data validation rules within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods to check if a cell's value conforms to specified criteria, such as list inclusion, numeric ranges, and text length.

classes.name: DataValidator
classes.description: Handles validation of cell values based on data validation rules within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks whether the given cell's value adheres to its data validation rules.

methods.name: numericOperator
methods.description: Performs comparison operations based on the data validation operator and formulas.

methods.name: isValueInList
methods.description: Determines if a cell's value exists within a specified list or range of values.
